verdict.rationale: Vue's official 'Ways of Using Vue' guide documents building desktop apps by reusing Vue code through Electron, Wails, Quasar or Tauri. However, those native shells are third-party projects, and the evidence shows no first-party desktop runtime or tooling. The createRenderer API is only a developer building block for non-DOM targets, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a first-party native desktop runtime or packaging tooling, in-depth docs on the desktop workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of desktop builds or their performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build native desktop applications by reusing my framework's component model and tooling
